paper_title: HeLIOS: The Superfluid Helium Ultralight Dark Matter Detector
suggested_experiment_name: Eot-Wash + LIGO/Virgo (existing B-L bounds shown in HeLIOS Fig.1)
notes: This is a projection/sensitivity paper for a superfluid helium optomechanical detector. It proposes searches for both scalar UDM (coupling to electron mass, d_me, ScalarElectron) and vector UDM (coupling to B-L number, g_B-L, VectorBL). The pre-analysis hint of VectorBL is consistent with the right panel of Fig. 1, but the paper equally constrains ScalarElectron (left panel). No numerical data points are given in tables or text — projections are shown only as curves in Fig. 1 (g_B-L axis spans ~1e-26 to 1e-16, masses ~1-50 peV). No exclusion limits are actually measured (thermal motion not observed in prototype). Mass range ~1-50 peV (kHz frequency range). Confidence kept low due to dual coupling types and absence of extractable numbers. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Right panel of Fig.1 is the vector UDM (g_BL) plot.
